header.title: Controller Parameters & Calibration
header.description: Read and write the parameters the firmware actually exposes: payload, feed-forward scaling, per-joint gains and soft limits, and the firmware self-test.

payload.title: End-effector payload
payload.desc: Mass and centre of mass of the tool/workpiece, used by the gravity feed-forward (feed-forward items 4 and 5).
payload.clampHint: The firmware silently clamps these values (mass to ≥ 0, COM to ±1 m) instead of rejecting them, so the line above shows the read-back value, not what was sent.

gravity.scaleHint: Feed-forward gain per joint; 1.0 is the firmware default.
gravity.vectorHint: Gravity unit vector in the base frame (feed-forward scalar item 6).
gravity.empty: No joint parameters read yet — the feed-forward channels follow the reported axis count.
gravity.channelHint: The firmware feed-forward vector is fixed at 7 channels and this arm reports {{count}}, so only these are shown. Saving still writes all 7.

joints.title: Per-joint gains and soft limits
joints.desc: MIT stiffness/damping/torque clamp, and the soft limits the control page takes its slider ranges from.
joints.factoryConfirm: Restore all parameters to factory defaults? This cannot be undone.
joints.persistHint: The firmware requires the arm to be disabled for flash writes, and rejects these while the drives are still enabled.

diagnostics.title: Firmware self-test
diagnostics.desc: Kinematics self-test plus link diagnostics (CRC errors, FIFO drops).
diagnostics.empty: Run the self-test to read the firmware's diagnostics counters.

activation.title: Device activation
activation.desc: This arm's activation state and device UID. An unactivated arm is refused by the firmware.
activation.uidHint: Give this 24-character hex string to your supplier to obtain the activation license for this machine. It is bound to this arm; another arm needs its own.
activation.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the UID above and copy it manually
activation.locked: This arm is not activated, so the firmware refuses to enable it. Give the device UID above to your supplier; once you have the license, it can be activated.
activation.activatedHint: This arm is activated and can be enabled normally.
activation.unreadableHint: The activation record could not be read this time: the firmware may not have the command, or the reply was lost. Press Refresh to retry; if it never reads, check the firmware version.
activation.staleRecord: The record below is from the last successful read; this read failed, so its state is not confirmed.
activation.unsupportedHint: This firmware has no activation query command (activation exists from firmware 1.8.0). Update the firmware first.
activation.offline: No arm connected — connect first to read the activation state.
activation.formDesc: These details are sent to the activation service together with the device UID; the service returns this machine's license.
activation.name: Name
activation.contactRequired: Fields marked * are required. The fields match the activation website's form.
activation.invalidName: Name must be 2-32 characters of letters only, with no digits
activation.invalidPhone: Phone must be an 11-digit number, e.g. 13800000000
activation.invalidEmail: Email format is not valid, e.g. name@example.com
activation.consentAgreeLabel: I have read and agree to
activation.consentIntro: Activation sends the items below to the activation service (act.nexform.tech). Each one states why it is needed - for nothing else, and no other field travels with it.
activation.consentItemContact: Name, phone, organisation, email, WeChat ID
activation.consentItemContactWhy: To issue the licence and to reach you when something needs sorting out (phone is faster on site).
activation.consentItemUsageWhy: To record where this machine is used and what for, as the basis for service and statistics.
activation.consentItemUidWhy: To identify this machine: the licence only works on it, and another machine needs its own.
activation.consentItemVersionsWhy: To tell which build you are running when diagnosing a problem.
activation.consentFooter: These items are used only to issue the licence, for support contact and for service records; contact your supplier to correct or delete them. See the
activation.mustDisable: The firmware only writes the licence record while disarmed: press Disable first.
activation.activatedJustNow: Activated: this arm is now unlocked.
activation.activatedUnconfirmed: Submitted, but the read-back did not confirm it: press Refresh to read this arm's activation state.

firmware.title: Firmware update (USB DFU)
firmware.intro: Write controller firmware (.hex / .bin) to the STM32. **The update disarms the arm first**, so it loses its holding torque: make sure it is resting or mechanically supported before you start.
firmware.engineHint: pyusb and libusb are required; Windows also needs the ST WinUSB driver.
firmware.notConnected: No controller connected — connect before updating.
firmware.safetyArm: The arm is disarmed and resting or supported (the motors release during the update, so a gravity-loaded arm will sag)
firmware.safetyStop: Emergency stop is unreachable during the update — the device is in the bootloader and the application is not running
firmware.safetyKeep: The licence and factory-calibration sectors are never touched; an image that covers them is refused outright
firmware.succeeded: Update finished: the device is back in the application and passed the read-back check.
firmware.warningTitle: Update finished, but one thing needs checking
firmware.goControl: Check the state on the control page
